name: Starlight Coast — expanded terrain and location plan
prompt:
TRANSFORM the supplied Starlight Coast draft into a STRICT TRUE TOP-DOWN PLANNING MAP. Retain its title WLD-MAP-001 — Starlight Coast,7.5kmx7.5km planning envelope, same25 B-ID families, same6 S-sites, coastline palette, approximate district layout and proposed routes. The draft is REJECTED because it draws upright facades in an oblique panorama. This revision MUST LOOK LIKE A FLAT OVERHEAD CARTOGRAPHIC SITE PLAN, camera exactly90degrees down.
CRITICAL GRAPHIC RULES:
- REMOVE EVERY STANDING BUILDING/FACADE/TOWER from the illustration. No upright castles, chapels, palaces, pagodas or cities at ANY landmark. Replace them with small FLAT roof/footprint/site symbols: labelled cream/rose/jade polygon pads, rings/oval stadium footprint, small connected roof rectangles for villages. No visible vertical walls, front gates or cone spire elevations. Nothing rises above the paper.
- B01 is a flat2.2km-wide by1.87km-deep reservation in the CENTRE, a softly chamfered/stepped rose/ivory plan outline only; do not design its actual courtyard/tower arrangement or show a front facade. Mark 'B01 PRINCESS PALACE — WORKING RESERVATION'. Keep a clear south arrival corridor.
- Mountains are mapped ONLY as soft hillshade and CLOSED CONTOUR BANDS in local NW fjord and NE misty areas. NO upright mountain peaks or side-facing cliff panoramas. Elsewhere forest is overhead canopy stipple, meadow/light land is flat.
- SKY insets are FLAT overhead island outlines/canopy areas in four dashed cloud rings S01/S02/S04/S05, not standing floating towers or exposed hanging cliff sides. T08 SKY SUBSTRATES label must be visible near the sky-inset key.
- Preserve open surrounding sea, but REMOVE the near-continuous ring of sea-stack rocks. Replace at least HALF the coast with broad low sand/dune/beach coves, especially west/lagoon and south/coastal meadow. Only localized offshore rock groups by fjord/cliff/canyon/lighthouse. Wave lines/foam patches uneven, crossing and broken; sea calm in bays, no perfect parallel stripe field.
- ALL B01..B25 labels appear exactly once as families on the main map (B20 may have two small pavilion instance pads under one family label); all S01..S06 present. Names/IDs sit beside simple footprints and thin callouts, not on front elevation panels.
- REMOVE THE OLD NUMERIC COORDINATE AXIS LABELS ENTIRELY; keep north-up compass and approximate0/1/2km scale bar. Do not introduce another erroneous grid. Footer should state 'DIAGRAMMATIC PROPOSED PLAN / EXACT PROPOSED ANCHORS IN LOCATION INDEX / NO VERIFIED TERRAIN OR ROUTE GEOMETRY'.
LOCATION PLACEMENT GUIDANCE on7.5km square, centre B01(0,0), east+X, south+Z. Palace reservation excludes neighboring buildings. B25 CONSERVATORY is a separate small pad north-west at(-1500,-1300), OUTSIDE palace reserve; B18 MOTHER TREE on west/south shore at(-1450,1450), OUTSIDE reserve. B17 GLOWWOOD RUINS(-2700,-1200) is north of Storybook Village. B11 CRESCENT ARCH(3100,1900) is near EAST shoreline, not west of Canyon Palace. Other anchors: B02 Moon Palace(-1100,1500), B03 Star Chapel(850,1450), B04 Rose Keep(-1700,-1500), B05 Misty Keep(2100,-1700), B06 Pagoda(2300,-1400), B07 Temple Hill(550,-1900), B08 Colosseum(-600,-2000), B09 Lagoon City(-2200,1200), B10 Canyon Palace(1900,2400), B12 Storybook Village(-2300,-650), B13 Windmill(-2600,-950), B14 Pillar City(2450,150), B15 Jungle Temple(2600,1250), B16 Fjord Longhouse(-2300,-2100), B19 Lantern Cove(-2200,2600), B20 bridge pavilion stops(-1550,2200)/(0,2350), B21 Tidal Observatory(-3050,1550), B22 Pearl Lighthouse(-2750,2600), B23 Sea Pavilion(1850,3100), B24 Reef Shrine(2900,2300).
Separate calm inland S03 LANTERN LAKE(-1950,650) west of palace from southern MOONWATER BASIN supporting raised B02/B03 island/shore pads. Main GOLD walk loop around western/northern/eastern districts; thin secondary forest paths; ONE white curved long bridge across southern basin from Lantern Cove through B20 to palace south axis. Boat routes blue dotted on water; sky connectors purple dotted with no ground roads to sky islands. Region IDs T01 Rose Grounds,T02 Lakes/Water Gardens,T03 Coast/Reef,T04 Jade Wetlands,T05 Glowwood/Meadow,T06 Fjord/Misty Hills,T07 Canyon,T08 Sky Substrates in small readable labels.
Aim for a CLEAN GEOGRAPHIC PLANNING DRAWING with beautifully colored terrain/water and exact named-location inventory. Simple symbols are preferable to any standing architecture. Do NOT reproduce the source panorama. No new buildings, no missing IDs, no palace enlargement beyond reserved2.2km width, no coordinate grid numbers. Keep legend/caption compact and room for open sea/beach terrain. All physical geometry/footprint boundaries remain proposals.
source_rule: One image for map vocabulary; coordinates/reservations/terrain geometry are proposals, not a recovered measured map. Original images preserved.

previous_attempts.prompt:
Create ONE detailed but clean TOP-DOWN TERRAIN AND LOCATION PLAN titled WLD-MAP-001 — Starlight Coast. Use ONLY the supplied old Starlight Coast expanded-world illustration for place identity, coastal/fantasy palette and broad district relationships. This new sheet is a TRUE VERTICAL OVERHEAD MAP, not another isometric panorama. NO front elevations, tall upright castle paintings or hidden topography behind mountains. Topographic watercolour/technical-map look on light ivory, north up, clear muted region fills and restrained contour lines. Landmarks are SMALL FOOTPRINT/SITE SYMBOLS or simple roof-plan shapes with exact B IDs plus short readable names. Main palace is a2.2km-wide working footprint reservation at centre, with softly angled/curved wing outline indicated only, not a redesigned castle facade. Its actual architectural authority is GEN-37; do not copy this old map castle silhouette into a new palace.
Extent:7.5km x7.5km, east+X right, south+Z down; map bounds-3750..3750m each axis. This ALREADY is3x the original width/depth; don't expand it again. Include north arrow, small0/1/2km scale, short legend; dimensions/coords are proposed planning guidance, NOT measured terrain. Carefully arrange markers using this common coordinate convention.
TERRAIN: broad irregular coastal island/peninsula, visible open sea to west/east/south, varied low beaches/dunes/coves and tidal shoreline. Mountains ONLY in local NW fjord and NE misty ridge groups; DO NOT encircle the map with mountains or put a sea-stack ring around every shore. ROUTES: thin GOLD primary paths from palace around west/north/east districts, lighter tan secondary village/forest paths. A legible SOUTH PALACE ARRIVAL AXIS toward basin and waterfront. Purple dotted SKY/PORTAL connectors to projected sky sites; never draw walkable ground roads to floating islands.

previous_attempts.rejection_reason: First draft remains an oblique standing-building panorama instead of a true overhead footprint map; sea stacks repeat along almost every shore and numeric axis labels are inconsistent. Flatten buildings/terrain and open the coast.

review_notes: R01 was an oblique panorama with standing buildings and inconsistent coordinate ticks. R02 replaces standing buildings with overhead site symbols, uses local hill contours, adds more low beaches and removes the erroneous grid. Both outputs are preserved.
B01–B25 and S01–S06 labels are visually present; T01–T08 are defined in region inventory/legend. This label review is not automated spatial/geometry validation.

The drawing remains diagrammatic: marker positions, footprint sizes, coastline and bridge-pavilion instance counts are not proven to match layout.json pixel-for-pixel. In particular, the B01 footprint drawing does not visibly establish its printed2.2x1.87km size relative to the whole envelope. Use that value as a proposed reservation, not as a measurement from this image.

The main palace reservation does not redefine GEN-37 facade, tower placement, height, stepped wings or roof courtyards. Legacy height/footprint mismatches are recorded; palace geometry remains unresolved separately.

Old coordinate conflicts are explicitly proposed relocations for B17/B18/B25/B11. Sky coordinates are horizontal projections only; S03 is an inland lake. No altitude/access/shoreline support geometry is validated.
Route lengths are proposed polyline arithmetic, not navigation/collision/terrain-grade or hydrological results. Sea waves are a design appearance, not a tested shader/simulation.
Existing GEN-05/06 boards cover other-building vocabulary; no complete architectural kit, foliage mesh, natural-object mesh or world build is produced here.
